questions.question: What is the safest thing to do before backing your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn right before you shift into reverse.
Walk around and check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
Check your rearview mirrors to see what is behind you.
Turn up the radio to alert people around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk around and check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: It is hard to see behind your vehicle when backing up. Walk to the back of your vehicle to check for children and small objects before you get in and back up.

questions.question: When leaving a highway, when should you slow down?

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
Once you see a toll booth.
After you move into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you move into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Move into the exit lane first. Then slow down after you are in the exit lane.

questions.question: When does your vehicle need more distance to stop?

options.text: On a wet or icy road.
On paved highways.
When driving at night.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a wet or icy road.
questions.explanation: Your vehicle needs more distance to stop on wet or icy roads. Loose gravel or stones also increase stopping distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: How far ahead must you signal before you turn?

options.text: 100 feet
50 feet
200 feet
300 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 100 feet
questions.explanation: You must signal for at least 100 feet before you turn or change lanes. Signal for a longer distance if you are going faster.

questions.question: What color are guide signs that show directions and distances?

options.text: Yellow
Red
Green
White

questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs are green. They show directions and distances to help you find where you need to go. They are helpful when you are driving in an unfamiliar area.

questions.question: What is the first step when parallel parking between two cars?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Stop parallel to the car in front of the parking space.
Back slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop parallel to the car in front of the parking space.
questions.explanation: First, check for traffic and signal. Stop parallel to the car directly in front of your parking space. Then turn your wheels to park.

questions.question: You see two solid yellow lines on a highway. When can you cross them?

options.text: Only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
To pass other vehicles if there is no oncoming traffic.
Never.
Only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You can only cross them to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.
They rarely use their headlights.
Motorcycle drivers are less skilled than other drivers.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are small and easy to miss. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge how far away they are or how fast they are going. Always watch carefully around motorcycles.

questions.question: What should you do when a traffic light turns yellow as you approach an intersection?

options.text: Keep going through the intersection.
Stop right away.
Stop before entering, unless you are too close to stop safely.
Speed up to get through before the red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering, unless you are too close to stop safely.
questions.explanation: When you see a yellow light, slow down and stop before you enter the intersection if you can do so safely. If you cannot stop safely, drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from specific lanes. What does a solid red arrow mean?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a red circular traffic light.
It means you may turn in the direction the arrow points.
It means traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a red circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same thing as a red circular traffic light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: If a green arrow changes to a solid green light, what should you do?

options.text: You may still turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
You must go straight and cannot turn.
You still have the right to turn without yielding.
You do not have to turn in the arrow's direction anymore.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may still turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: When a green arrow changes to a solid green light, you can still turn in that direction. However, you must first yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Why does the road become especially slippery during the first half hour of rain?

options.text: Dust and oil on the road have not been washed away yet.
Tires have not absorbed the water yet.
Water pools the most at the start of rainfall.
It rains the hardest at that time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Dust and oil on the road have not been washed away yet.
questions.explanation: Roads are slippery at the start of rain because dirt and oil have not been washed away. Water mixes with these materials to create a greasy film that tires cannot grip well.

questions.question: When you turn left onto a one-way street, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The right lane.
The lane closest to the lane you were just in.
Either lane.
Neither lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to the lane you were just in.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane that is closest to the lane you were just in.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalk, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: On the side with the lightest traffic.
On the same side where traffic is moving.
On the side facing oncoming traffic.
On the side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians should walk on the side of the road facing the traffic coming toward them.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Drive carefully through the intersection.
Get ready to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should drive slowly and carefully through the intersection. Look both ways before proceeding.

questions.question: A school bus is stopped and showing flashing amber lights. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and stay stopped until the bus leaves.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
Honk and pass slowly.
Speed up and pass quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When you see a stopped school bus with flashing amber lights, you must slow down and prepare to stop. You must come to a complete stop when the bus turns on its flashing red lights.

questions.question: What color are the lines that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?

options.text: Yellow
White
Yellow and white
Yellow, white, and black

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What is the first thing you should adjust when you get in a car to drive?

options.text: Your seat belt
The steering wheel
Your rearview mirror
Your seat

questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat
questions.explanation: First adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: You come to an intersection blocked by traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Go slowly until the traffic moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front.
Stay out of the intersection until you can cross it completely.
Honk your horn to make cars move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can cross it completely.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if you cannot drive completely through it. Wait until the traffic ahead clears so you do not block the intersection.
